description: Cloud networking decomposed. VPC design patterns, subnet sizing, route tables, NAT cost optimization, PrivateLink architecture, Transit Gateway scaling, AWS Cloud WAN, multi-region peering.

sub_mechanisms.name: VPC_CIDR_planning
sub_mechanisms.definition: Choose CIDR for VPC. Larger = more IPs but harder to peer (overlap). RFC 1918 ranges.
sub_mechanisms.why: Future-proof: hard to expand once chosen. Avoid overlap with future peers. /16 typical for VPC; /24 per subnet common.

sub_mechanisms.name: public_vs_private_subnet
sub_mechanisms.definition: Public: route to IGW (internet). Private: route via NAT (outbound only) or VPC endpoints.
sub_mechanisms.why: App servers private; LBs in public. Databases private. Standard 3-tier pattern. Public IPs only on what needs them.

sub_mechanisms.name: NAT_gateway_cost
sub_mechanisms.definition: ~$0.045/hour + $0.045/GB processed. Major cost driver for chatty private workloads.
sub_mechanisms.why: Calling AWS APIs from private subnet = NAT cost. VPC endpoints eliminate. Common 'wait, why is this so expensive?' bill investigation.

sub_mechanisms.name: VPC_endpoint_gateway
sub_mechanisms.definition: Endpoints for S3 + DynamoDB. Route table entries. Free.
sub_mechanisms.why: Avoid NAT for S3/DDB traffic. No data charges. Should always be enabled. Older gateway endpoint type.

sub_mechanisms.name: VPC_endpoint_interface_PrivateLink
sub_mechanisms.definition: ENI in your VPC with private DNS. Access AWS services + 3rd-party services. Hourly + data.
sub_mechanisms.why: More services than gateway endpoints. Lower data charge than NAT. Slightly higher than gateway endpoints.

sub_mechanisms.name: Transit_Gateway_hub
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hub for many VPC + VPN + Direct Connect attachments. Transitive routing.
sub_mechanisms.why: Replaces N×N peering at ~4+ VPCs. ~$36/mo + per-GB. Standard for enterprise multi-VPC.

sub_mechanisms.name: Cloud_WAN
sub_mechanisms.definition: AWS Cloud WAN: managed global network. Multi-region TGW orchestration with policy.
sub_mechanisms.why: Beyond TGW: cross-region built-in. Policy-driven (intent-based). Modern alternative for global enterprises.

sub_mechanisms.name: VPC_peering_non_transitive
sub_mechanisms.definition: A↔B + B↔C does not give A↔C. Each pair needs explicit peer.
sub_mechanisms.why: Common architecture mistake. TGW solves transitive. Or full mesh peering (N² complexity).

sub_mechanisms.name: Direct_Connect_AWS
sub_mechanisms.definition: Dedicated network link AWS ↔ on-premises. Low latency, predictable.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hybrid cloud baseline. VPN over internet variable; Direct Connect dedicated. Hundreds Mbps to 100 Gbps. Costs $$$$.

sub_mechanisms.name: AWS_Global_Accelerator
sub_mechanisms.definition: Anycast IPs + AWS network. Steer traffic into AWS backbone closer to user.
sub_mechanisms.why: Better routing than open internet. Faster + more reliable. Used for global apps. Compared to CloudFront: GA is L4, CF is L7 + caching.

sub_mechanisms.name: cross_region_VPC_peering
sub_mechanisms.definition: Peer VPCs across regions. AWS backbone, not internet.
sub_mechanisms.why: Multi-region apps. Lower latency than VPN. Standard for active-active deployments.

sub_mechanisms.name: AWS_PrivateLink_3rd_party
sub_mechanisms.definition: Vendor exposes service via PrivateLink. Customer accesses without internet.
sub_mechanisms.why: Datadog, Snowflake, MongoDB all offer PrivateLink. Better security + no NAT cost. Standard for SaaS in regulated environments.

derivation_rules.name: VPC_endpoints_critical_for_cost
if: VPC has chatty AWS API workloads
then: VPC endpoints save thousands monthly vs NAT
derivation_rules.why: Per-GB NAT charge × TB of API traffic = thousands. Endpoints: same access without NAT data charges. Standard cost optimisation.

derivation_rules.name: TGW_economical_at_4_plus_VPCs
if: 4 or more VPCs need full connectivity
then: Transit Gateway cheaper than peering mesh
derivation_rules.why: N(N-1)/2 peerings: management complexity grows. TGW: linear with N attachments. Cost crossover ~$80/mo (TGW vs peering free at low count).

derivation_rules.name: PrivateLink_eliminates_internet_for_SaaS
derivation_rules.why: Without: VPC → NAT → internet → vendor. With: VPC → PrivateLink → vendor. Lower latency, lower cost, better security. Standard for regulated industries.

derivation_rules.name: subnet_sizing_for_future_growth
derivation_rules.why: Can't easily expand CIDR after creation. Overlap with future peers/TGW = blocked. Plan with 4-10x current need. Common mistake: /24 VPC, run out fast.

derivation_rules.name: cross_AZ_data_transfer_charges
derivation_rules.why: Not free even within VPC. Multi-AZ HA costs data transfer. Topology-aware routing (zone-aware Kafka, Cassandra) keeps in-AZ when possible.
